name: libarchive
summary: Upstream archive command-line tools compiled for browser WebAssembly with reproducible source and toolchain pins.

profiles.label: Browser Full
profiles.output: Four generic upstream archive CLIs; archive files are chosen by CLI arguments
profiles.size: Loaded from the published release manifest

integration.summary: Self-host the runtime wrapper plus the core pair for each libarchive CLI you use. This example extracts a ZIP with bsdtar.
integration.example:
<script src="/vendor/libarchive/browser-libarchive.js"></script>
<script type="module">
async function extractZip(file) {
  const archive = WasmZooLibarchive.loadHosted({
    baseUrl: "/vendor/libarchive/"
  });

  try {
    const result = await archive.exec(
      "bsdtar",
      ["-xf", "/input.zip", "-C", "/out"],
      {
        files: [{ name: "/input.zip", data: file }],
        dirs: ["/out"],
        collectDirs: ["/out"]
      }
    );
    return result.files;
  } finally {
    archive.dispose();
  }
}
</script>
notes: No SharedArrayBuffer or cross-origin isolation is required for the browser-full profile.
For bsdcpio, bsdcat or bsdunzip, also host the matching <tool>-core.js and <tool>-core.wasm pair.
Extracted files are returned from MEMFS as Uint8Array data.

comparison.name: WASM Zoo
comparison.note: Upstream bsdtar/bsdcpio/bsdcat/bsdunzip CLIs with browser filesystem constraints and zlib+bzip2 enabled.

notes: v0.3.1 is the first metadata-enabled libarchive release: the WebAssembly feature set is unchanged from v0.3.0, while standalone SLSA provenance and CycloneDX SBOM assets are added to the release contract.
The browser profile is single-threaded and does not require SharedArrayBuffer or cross-origin isolation.
Files live in Emscripten MEMFS during each command; native filesystem metadata and process semantics are not equivalent to a desktop build.
The browser-full profile intentionally leaves xz/LZMA, Zstandard, LZ4, LZO, XML and crypto backends disabled and records those gaps explicitly.
The real Chromium smoke test lists and extracts a ZIP/Deflate fixture and also instantiates the other published CLI cores.
Emscripten 6.0.6 pins zlib 1.3.2 and bzip2 1.0.6 for the enabled ports; their license notices ship with the binary release.

capabilityMatrix.note: The Zoo build publishes all four upstream CLI entry points.
Core archive formats remain compiled into the static tools.
Uses the pinned Emscripten zlib port.
Uses the pinned Emscripten bzip2 port.
External LZMA backend intentionally disabled for browser-full.
OpenSSL, mbedTLS and Nettle are not linked.
Browser execution uses MEMFS; host ACL/xattr behavior does not map directly.
